title: NavigationStateContract
description: Standardized navigation state contract produced autonomously by edge mobile navigation engine (DEV3) and ingested by Main Backend (DEV2) in offline telemetry batches.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for the active navigation session.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of position estimate.

altitude.description: Altitude in meters above sea level.

velocity.description: Speed estimate in meters per second.

heading.description: Heading / bearing in degrees true north.

confidence.description: Normalized confidence score of position estimation (0.0 to 1.0).

navigation_mode.description: Active dead reckoning / fusion mode operating on edge mobile.

gnss_status.description: GNSS fix availability on edge device.

model_version.description: Semantic version of ONNX model running on mobile.

map_version.description: Semantic version of offline map package in use.
